Back to valuation

Terminal-growth review

2026-10-18 · Analyst scenario judgment, not a Damodaran prescription or issuer forecast. Optional annual and terminal uncertainty is supported; the research default holds terminal growth fixed at the reviewed rate. Review date is not a new valuation date.

Original annual paths, capital budgets, WACC, ROIC, claim adjustments and valuation dates remain unchanged by the terminal review.

At an illustrative 2% inflation anchor, 3.0% nominal USD implies approximately 0.98% real growth; 2.5% implies approximately 0.49%. PCE inflation is not a company price index. Evidence does not uniquely identify 3.0%.

Methodology and dated sources

damodaran · Undated methodology
Methodology, undated historical examples; not a current macro forecast.

fed_sep · 2026-09-16
Long-run USD inflation/US real-economy context; PCE inflation is not the GDP deflator and policy rate is not 10-year risk-free.

treasury · 2026-10-16
Independently verified latest available observation as of October 18; ceiling reference, not a perpetual growth recommendation.

cbc · 2026-09-17
Near-term inflation context only; does not validate a long-run 1.5% TWD assumption or establish a terminal growth forecast.

imf · 2026-10-13
Near-term global real-growth context only; neither number is a perpetual nominal USD/TWD rate. Do not add world aggregate inflation to USD cash flows.

The 4.0647% TWD rate reference is synthetic, using the existing 1.5% TWD and 2% USD long-run inflation assumptions with the 5.09% USD Treasury reference. It is not an observed Taiwan bond yield. Taiwan near-term CPI does not validate the long-run assumption.

Selected Google case

The selected case uses the exact audited 20-year annual path, 35% operating margin by year 5, 10% WACC, 16% terminal ROIC and 3% terminal growth. Annual source-calendar investment floors and funded expansion are retained.

First-three-year revenue growth, calculated from the exact annual rows: 24.5745%, 23.7399%, 20.3321%.

June 30 conditional per-share allocations: selected case $306.616907; original case $210.132522; terminal-only reviewed comparison $214.860845.

The last explicit year still grows 2.5%, followed by 3% continuation. These are selected scenario assumptions with unresolved-claim limitations, not new issuer guidance or an October valuation. Use the comparison action or original-operating-path action to inspect the alternatives.
